start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Nooo! I can’t need money this badly!

start.speaker: Customer
start.text: Why don’t you make yourself a cake that’ll make you rich?

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: No thanks! I once wished for a sweet ride, and look what I got! But I’m sure whatever you want will go wonderfully, lamb.

start.speaker: Customer
start.text: I need a cake that’ll “off” my neighbor.

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: I’m afraid my “Final Farewell” cakes aren’t working, dear. I’ve sold six this week with your name on them.

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Only joking… Six was an exaggeration.

good_result.speaker: Fairy
good_result.text: Now, that’s a cake to die for! …Okay, not my best work. The joke. The cake’s lethal.

bad_result.speaker: Fairy
bad_result.text: Well, that’ll certainly offend your neighbor, but not off them. Less jail time, though.

hint.speaker: Fairy
hint.text: What will stop the ticking and thoroughly silence the neighbor?
